note: Build sites. `needs` is the pile of materials the site accepts a few at a time; `permit` is the bank paperwork it will not break ground without; `unlocks` is the flag the finished shop sets, which is how rooms.json opens its door. `income` is paid into the wallet once each in-game morning the shop is standing.
